comment: The lenses this factory declares BEYOND the instrument's core catalogue. The core catalogue is the instrument's SHAPE and is centralised by the frame (docs/instruments/template-instruments.md): a member cannot fork it, and tools/review.py refuses a lens outside the lawful set. Declare here when this factory carries subject matter the core catalogue has no lens for -- a factory's own domain-rule sweep, say -- and it becomes a lawful lens for THIS factory without forking the engine. One reader (known_lenses / lens_metadata) folds it into every path, so brief, record, waive, status, verify, close and compile all see it. A declaration ADDS; it never removes or redefines a core lens: a declared id that collides with a core letter (A-S) is DROPPED, so the core entry keeps the law that letter carries. A member's own lens is read as the review's SUBJECT, never folded into how the instrument reads. This file ships EMPTY: a factory that declares nothing carries no dead vocabulary, and the field ships before any factory has used it.
